landed_against.rule: R-17: this slice declares every diff path here and re-captures all three baselines in the same commit.

what_landed: Varus' Blight detonation reads the stack level his own swings applied, walked in the cached 6-second window (Case 6). The per-cast pricing seam is threaded into post_hit_proc, because the detonation rides one.
why: blight_stacks defaulted to the sourced maximum, so a fight with no swings at all still detonated three stacks. Varus' own basic attacks are what apply Blight, so the level is a count of hits and the golden's scenarios land fewer than three inside the window.
Every moved leaf is Varus' and they move DOWN, by the stacks the fight did not apply.
